However, one day, they receive an email threatening their relationship.

item.description:

  • スコア: 5.63/10 (131 人評価)
  • 日本語名: エロ本を捨ててから兄の様子がおかしい
  • 英語名: Erohon o Sutete kara Ani no Yousu ga Okashii

あらすじ

The story is about a protagonist, Yukawa Haruto, whose bratty sister, Momoka, throws away his borrowed erotic books and DVDs. As an apology to the owner of those items, he starts secretly filming his sister changing clothes and taking bath. As he does this, he begins to develop forbidden feelings for her. Meanwhile, Momoka is aware of the filming but pretends not to notice, and she finds herself enjoying her brother’s gaze. Their relationship escalates, and one day, when Momoka feels the time has come, she opens her eyes only to find her brother’s friend about to assault her instead of her brother. Haruto’s twisted feelings lead to a tragic turn of events.

item.title: Hatsujou Switch ~Bishimai ga Saiminjutsu ni Ochita Saki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lamia
  • 発売日: 2014-12-19
  • スコア: 6.2/10 (75 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 発情スイッチ ～美姉妹が催眠術に堕ちた先～
  • 英語名: Hatsujou Switch Bishimai ga Saiminjutsu ni Ochita Saki

别名

  • Hatsujyou Switch

あらすじ

The main character, Matsuri Gen’ya, works as a counselor at St. Luitos Academy. After losing a power struggle at the hospital where he used to work, he was forced out and lost everything. Now, he uses hypnosis to manipulate female students under the guise of counseling. He makes them serve him, assaults them, and vents his frustrations during his boring days. One day, his colleague, a doctor named Sakura, lets slip that late professor Kirihara, whom Gen’ya respected as a mentor, left behind a special “inheritance”. The principal is searching for it desperately, but its nature is unknown. Gen’ya decides to investigate by questioning Kirihara’s daughters, Megumu and Saki, and extracting more information from Sakura. He’s determined to use any means necessary to reclaim what he lost and will not let anyone stand in his way. The curtain rises on his tale of revenge.
